scripts.dev: npm run banner && npx concurrently -k -n WEB,API,BOT -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm:dev:client" "npm:dev:server" "npm run dev:bot"
scripts.build: echo [BUILD 1/3] Building website (client)... && npm --workspace=client run build && echo [BUILD 2/3] Building API server... && npx tsc --project server/tsconfig.json && echo [BUILD 3/3] Building Discord bot... && npx tsc --project bot/tsconfig.json && echo [BUILD] ALL 3 PARTS BUILT SUCCESSFULLY
scripts.prod: npx concurrently "npm --workspace=server run start" "npm --workspace=bot run start"
